Anya (PM): Quick sync idea — propose we split the Optimize toolkit into three parallel tracks: 1) batching/caching ops, 2) quantization recommendation engine, 3) eval-triggered alerts for regressions. Want to align on launch criteria and customer asks.
Luis (Eng): +1 on tracks. Curious about dependencies — batching and caching share runtime work but quant recs need model metrics from ML.
Rina (ML): Correct. Quant recs need per-workload evals and a lightweight eval runner. We can reuse parts of the eval infra but need ~2 weeks to stabilize thresholds.
Sam (CS): Field asks: two enterprise customers want prescriptive quant recs (e.g., 8-bit vs 4-bit risk levels) and one startup wants batch tuning suggestions for mobile latency. All asked for rollout by Q3.
Tori (Design): For UX, we should provide a confidence score and an action button (apply recommendation / preview tokens delta). Mockups in Figma soon.
Luis (Eng): Operationally, batching/caching rollout must include safe defaults (no KV cache enabled by default for private deploy) and a toggle in Console. Also need autoscale tests.
Rina (ML): For eval-triggered alerts: suggest two signal types — quality regressions (concordance drop on golden prompts) and token-level cost spikes. Define thresholds: quality drop > 3% absolute on core prompt set OR 95th token cost > baseline * 1.5. Thoughts?
Anya (PM): Those thresholds sound reasonable as starting gates. We should make thresholds editable per-tenant. Launch criteria proposal: (a) batching/caching: load test p99 < target and no silent correctness regressions on smoke prompts; (b) quant recs: validation harness + 5 customer pilot passes; (c) eval alerts: alerting pipeline + two staffed runbooks.
Sam (CS): Can we tie pilot customers to specific acceptance criteria? I'll volunteer ACMEHealth for quant recs and QuillChat for batching.
Luis (Eng): Timeline feasibility: batching/caching MVP + autoscale tests = 4 weeks; quant recs MVP = 6 weeks (includes eval infra); eval-alerts pipeline = 3 weeks but needs QA on noisy signals.
Tori (Design): I'll prepare a compact UI pattern that surfaces recs and the toggles. Need spec for metadata in the API to show expected latency/cost delta.
Anya (PM): Action items: 1) Luis: detailed infra work breakdown for batching/caching by EOD Friday, 2) Rina: draft eval harness + sample thresholds and sample golden prompt set, 3) Sam: confirm pilot contacts and their availability, 4) Tori: Figma mock by next Wed.
Luis (Eng): Noted. Also flag: default quant recommendations should pass a quick smoke that runs <= 30s per model to avoid blocking.
Rina (ML): Agreed — implement a fast, sampled evaluation first, then full eval as background job.
Sam (CS): I'll loop in ACMEHealth and QuillChat this afternoon.
DeployBot: Reminder — please file an RFC for any Console toggles before UI work starts.
Anya (PM): Good call — I'll open the RFC and link the design/infra tickets. If no objections, we'll sync Monday to finalize scope slices for alpha. :thumbsup:
Luis (Eng): No objections from infra side.
Tori (Design): OK for Monday.
Rina (ML): OK.
Sam (CS): OK.
